research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Notable Labs is focused on developing personalized cancer treatment strategies through drug combination testing. They explore combinations of protein kinase C agonists with steroids or retinoic acids to synergistically increase antigen expression on cancer cells. Additionally, they investigate methods for treating proliferative diseases by targeting novel priming-eligible targets, utilizing compositions comprising priming agents. These efforts aim to enhance the effectiveness of cancer therapies through innovative drug combinations and targeted treatment approaches.

about_short_description.short_description: Notable Labs provides personalized drug combination testing service for cancer patients.

product.name: Predictive Medicine Platform
product.description: A platform that bio-simulates cancer treatment responses at the cellular level to predict patient-specific drug efficacy.

product.name: Biosimulation Assays
product.description: Computer-aided mathematical simulations that model biological responses of cancer cells to drugs for personalized treatment predictions.

product.name: Robotic Automation
product.description: An automated system that processes cell cultures and patient samples to standardize and accelerate drug response testing.

product.name: Predictive Algorithms
product.description: Algorithms that analyze biological data to predict the likelihood of a patient's positive response to specific cancer treatments.

product.name: Biological Response Database
product.description: A large database containing extensive biological response data from blood cancer patient samples used to inform drug development and treatment predictions.

product.name: Ntbl-201 (Volasertib + PRD-AML)
product.description: A therapeutic program combining the drug Volasertib with a predicted responder diagnostic to treat relapsed/refractory acute myeloid leukemia.
